Subject: Renewal QBR & Roadmap demo — sequencing, on-call coverage, and accessibility

Hi Katie —

Thanks again for the time last week. As we lock in the Renewal QBR/demo for Lumina, a couple of operational asks so we can make the session tight and low-risk on your side:

- Proposed format: 60min live walkthrough (features + migration checklist) followed by a 30min roadmap Q&A with execs. We can compress to 45/30 if your execs prefer shorter.
- Goal: show the Dedicated deployment performance profile, migration playbook, and the rollout timeline that connects to your FY27 priorities.
- Windows we're holding: Tue 2 Jun 10:00–11:30 PDT, Wed 3 Jun 08:00–09:30 PDT, Thu 4 Jun 16:00–17:30 PDT — pick a primary + fallback and we’ll reserve hosts.

Operational items we need from you to finalize calendar invites:
1) Recording consent + sharing scope (internal only vs include partners).
2) Any accessibility requirements (live captions, translations). We can bring live auto-captions + we have an interpreter vendor if you need human translation.
3) Primary attendees list per segment (engineering/infra, security/compliance, product exec).

Ben will be the primary demo host and Marissa will lead the roadmap discussion; I’ll act as program owner and handle logistics/backups. I’ve attached a draft agenda and a runbook placeholder for your review.

If those three windows look OK, pick one and I’ll send calendar invites and a short pre-read.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hi Soojin —

Thanks — and yes, this is great. A few quick notes from our side:

- Preferred: Wed 3 Jun 08:00–09:30 PDT (that hits 11:00–12:30 here EST for our execs).
- Recording: OK with internal distribution only; we will not share externally without a redline. Please mark the invite accordingly.
- Accessibility: we would like live captions and can do human translation if it’s expensive. Do you have an estimate for interpreter coverage?
- Attendees: I’ll send a final attendee list by Monday but expect: 2x product execs, 1x CISO, 2x infra engs, 1x procurement.

One more ask — our procurement lead will want a short run-through of the renewal terms and any migration credits. Can that be a 10–15 minute appendix after the Q&A? If yes, please include a slide or note in the pre-read.

—Katie
